summary: Completed comprehensive testing of mobile responsiveness fixes and weather widget feature. Backend regression tests passed 93% (53/57, with 4 failures due to test data collisions from previous runs, not actual bugs). Frontend tests passed 100% - verified NO horizontal overflow at all viewports (390x844 mobile, 768x1024 tablet, 1366x800 desktop), WeatherWidget renders correctly with 4-day forecast using workplace GPS, simple mode toggle works with tile dashboard, all tiles navigate correctly, simple mode persists after reload, record form Yes/No gating works, exception form present, and push panel visible.

backend_issues.notes: 4 test failures in backend_test.py are due to overlapping leave request dates from previous test runs (409 conflicts), not actual bugs. All regression endpoints work correctly.

frontend_issues.notes: Push toggle button not visible on /vice page when browser blocks notifications - this is CORRECT behavior per More.jsx logic (only shows toggle when pushState.supported && pushState.permission !== 'denied'). Not a bug.
